footer.about: AgroHub helps farmer cooperatives sell their harvests together. Buyers pay upfront and the payment is held until delivery is confirmed.

photo.signUp: Every cooperative is checked by AgroHub before it can sell.
photo.join: Buyers deal only with your cooperative. Your phone number stays private.

hero.lead: Verified cooperatives sell their members' harvests to bulk buyers in one catalogue. The buyer pays in full upfront, and the payment is held until delivery is confirmed.
hero.checked: Every cooperative is checked by AgroHub before it can sell.
hero.takeHomeNote: Farmers see what they take home before they agree to sell.
hero.photoAlt: A farmer carrying a bundle of harvested rice across a paddy field
hero.crops: Rice, maize, yam and more, sold together

how.title: How a sale works
how.lead: One catalogue for the whole cooperative, one payment from the buyer, and a share for every farmer who contributed.

list.title: A farmer lists a lot
list.body: Crop, quantity, grade and an asking price. A private lowest price stays hidden from every buyer.

approve.title: An officer approves it
approve.body: The cooperative's officer checks the lot and its price before any buyer can see it.

pay.title: The buyer pays in full
pay.body: Payment goes through Paystack and is held by AgroHub, never by the cooperative or an officer.

deliver.title: Delivery confirmed, everyone paid
deliver.body: When the buyer confirms delivery, the cooperative and each farmer receive their share by bank transfer.

landing.promise: A farmer sees exactly what they will earn before they agree to sell, and nobody in between can hold or redirect that money.

calc.title: Know what you take home before you sell
calc.lead: Change the price or the quantity. This is the breakdown a farmer sees before submitting a lot, and the terms are locked once an officer approves it. This example uses a 5% cooperative cut and a 3% AgroHub fee.
calc.enterNumbers: Enter a price in naira and a whole number.

roles.title: One platform, a screen for every role
roles.lead: Each role sees only what it needs.

buyers.what: Browse verified lots, make an offer, pay once.

farmers.what: Join by invite link, then list a harvest and see the earnings first.

officers.what: Approve lots, answer offers, mark deliveries.

admins.what: Verify each cooperative before it can sell.

holds.a: AgroHub holds it in its Paystack balance until delivery is confirmed. No cooperative or officer can hold, delay or redirect it.

when.a: As soon as the buyer confirms delivery. If the buyer does not respond, payment is released automatically three days after the officer marks the order delivered.

contact.a: No. Buyers deal with the cooperative through in-app messages. Phone numbers are visible only to AgroHub admins.

lower.q: What if a buyer offers less than my price?
lower.a: An officer can accept offers at or above your private lowest price. Below it, you decide. Buyers never learn your lowest price, even when an offer is turned down.

verified.a: Its officer uploads the state registration certificate, by-laws and officer list. An AgroHub admin reviews them, and the cooperative renews them every year.

cost.q: What does it cost a farmer?
cost.a: The cooperative's cut and AgroHub's fee, both shown before you agree and locked to your lot once it is approved. The calculator above uses 5% and 3% as an example.
